findings.detail: The medium explicitly says the stored date and discharge claim are inaccurate. The long repeatedly discusses what the source notes and supplied materials do not establish, then describes what the record does and does not claim. These correction and evidence-gap notes interrupt the explanation of the order and its implementation.

The long ends by saying the “earlier claim” that all members were dismissed and every function paralyzed “overstates the event.” This is correction guidance about an earlier draft rather than reader-facing context about the agencies’ quorum limits.

The long says “This entry records” the withdrawal rather than later negotiations and then explains which distinction is important. These catalog-style notes are unnecessary after the reader-facing account of the signed but unratified TPP and the absence of a replacement agreement.

The medium and long discuss what the “reviewed Commission history” confirms or fails to substantiate and say the additional allegations cannot be presented without independent sourcing. This is source-review commentary embedded in the account of the license reservation.

The long repeats “No criminal court adjudicated the allegation” twice and ends with a source-gap note that the NDA terms have not been established “here.” The repeated caveat and internal wording interrupt the account of the deposition and Ivana Trump’s later statements.

The long says the 2010 report does not document a later settlement, separates the report from a legal finding, and ends by requesting a source for the settlement proceeding. This leaves the 2011 settlement in the title and supplied context unexplained and turns the long into a source-gap note.

The closing paragraph discusses what the linked 1973 article fails to establish, how the supplied context should be read, and which details remain unverified. These source-review notes dominate the conclusion instead of explaining the reported tenant conditions.
